run_experiment_program: run a launchpad benchmarking program using an ExperimentConfig with learner and stream settings
config_from_config_dict: construct a typed ExperimentConfig from an ml_collections ConfigDict with stream and learner fields
create_experiment_config: create an ExperimentConfig dataclass with resume checkpoint path, stream config, and learner config
create_learner_config: create a LearnerConfig dataclass with a MetaLearnerBuilderFn and ml_collections ConfigDict
create_stream_config: create a StreamConfig dataclass with a stream constructor callable and keyword arguments mapping
